title: Practice 4: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded as well as the establishments being managed are denoted by the instrumental case: *Полковник командует полком. Петров заведует библиотекой.* With разговаривать the other participant is always denoted by с + instr.: *Я разговариваю с женой. To occupy (busy) oneself with, to be engaged in, to study — заниматься. This verb may be followed by the Instrumental case: *Он занимается политикой. Я занимаюсь спортом. Чем вы занимаетесь? To make use of; to enjoy (the rights, privileges, confidence, etc.) — пользоваться. The object following this verb is in the Instrumental case: *Они пользуются всеми правами. Я часто… — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 30, 65, 66, 99.  ·  «After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded … are denoted by the instrumental case.» «This verb (заниматься) may be followed by the Instrumental case.» «The object following this verb (пользоваться) is in the Instrumental case.» — DLI, Lessons 30, 65, 99.

Петров заведует библиотекой.* With разговаривать the other participant is always denoted by с + instr.: *Я разговариваю с женой. To occupy (busy) oneself with, to be engaged in, to study — заниматься. This verb may be followed by the Instrumental case: *Он занимается политикой. Я занимаюсь спортом. Чем вы занимаетесь? To make use of; to enjoy (the rights, privileges, confidence, etc.) — пользоваться. The object following this verb is in the Instrumental case: *Они пользуются всеми правами. Я часто… — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 30, 65, 66, 99.  ·  «After the verbs командовать and заведовать the units or persons being commanded … are denoted by the instrumental case.» «This verb (заниматься) may be followed by the Instrumental case.» «The object following this verb (пользоваться) is in the Instrumental case.» — DLI, Lessons 30, 65, 99.
